shots.title: Define checkout-EOL-safe projection comparison without hiding semantic drift (#591)
shots.notes: The comparison contract normalizes CRLF pairs only and keeps every other byte-level difference visible.

shots.title: Normalize generated projection bytes at the comparison and write boundary across CRLF checkouts (#591)
shots.notes: Compile checks, validation, and locked writes share one narrow comparator; archive integrity remains exact-byte.

shots.title: Add Windows autocrlf and true semantic-drift regression fixtures (#591)
shots.notes: Regression coverage proves CRLF equivalence, non-mutation, and rejection of whitespace, newline, bare-CR, and semantic drift.

conditions.description: Git line-ending conversion changes checkout bytes without changing the generated JSON projection.

training.description: Generated-file drift checks must distinguish checkout transport changes from authored content changes.
training.outcome: Normalize only the platform EOL pair at checkout comparison boundaries.

nutrition.description: The full repository test suite and 23 focused source-federation tests passed.

nineteenth_hole.how_did_it_feel: A small compatibility bug became straightforward once transport normalization was kept separate from semantic normalization.
nineteenth_hole.advice_for_next_player: Keep canonical serialization strict and normalize only at checkout-facing equality boundaries.
nineteenth_hole.what_surprised_you: A plain compile could rewrite an otherwise current CRLF checkout unless the write boundary shared the same comparator.
nineteenth_hole.excited_about_next: Roadmap federation now behaves consistently on Windows without weakening drift protection.

bunker_locations: Do not trim, parse, or reserialize both sides of a generated-file drift comparison; that can hide real drift.
yardage_book_updates: roadmapProjectionMatches is the checkout-facing equality boundary for generated roadmap projections.
course_management_notes: Implementation and review evidence are committed and pushed; no PR merge or release is implied.
